# Diogo Fitness

> Diogo Fitness (Diogo Fit) is one-to-one online fitness coaching from Diogo Camera, based in South Florida, for clients anywhere in the world.

Coaching is online and sold only through a conversation: there are no prices on this site. Apply at https://diogofit.com/apply/.

## Start here

- How it runs: a program in the Trainerize app, two weigh-ins a week, progress photos every two weeks, a weekly call, and messages in between. Online, for clients anywhere.
- [How one-to-one coaching with Diogo works](https://diogofit.com/coaching/)
- [What online fitness coaching is](https://diogofit.com/learn/what-is-online-fitness-coaching/)
- [How to choose an online fitness coach](https://diogofit.com/learn/how-to-choose-an-online-fitness-coach/)
- [Who Diogo Camera is](https://diogofit.com/about/)
- [Questions and answers](https://diogofit.com/faq/)
- [Apply](https://diogofit.com/apply/)
